description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Printer class, which provides methods for rendering HTML content by generating HTML tags, escaping content, and formatting output for the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering or printing HTML content, providing methods to generate HTML tags, escape content, and format output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for HTMLPurifier_Printer class, initializes the printer object.

methods.name: prepareGenerator
methods.description: Prepares and initializes the generator object using the provided configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns a start tag for a given HTML tag with optional attributes.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an end tag for a given HTML tag.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns a complete element with start and end tags, and optional escaped content.

methods.name: elementEmpty
methods.description: Returns an empty HTML element (self-closing tag).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns a text node, properly generated.

methods.name: row
methods.description: Creates a table row with a key and value, with formatting for boolean values.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe HTML output.

methods.name: listify
methods.description: Converts a list of strings into a formatted list, optionally adding 'and' before the last item.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of an object without the prefix and includes metadata or values based on object type.
